title: Rubber Soul
notes:
First UK pressing of the Loud Cut version with serif text on both labels. A version with sans-serif labels can be found [url=http://www.discogs.com/Beatles-Rubber-Soul/release/4816760]here[/url] and a serif/sans-serif version can be found [url=http://www.discogs.com/Beatles-Rubber-Soul/release/4965386]here[/url].
Sleeve printed by Garrod and Lofthouse. 
KT tax code on side 1
